bibl.title: A Case of Divine Adultery Investigated.
bibl.seg: Amr Gaber, A Case of Divine Adultery Investigated.
bibl.note: Plutarchus, De Iside et Osiride 356e. - 1. The marriage of Seth and Nephthys. - 2. The relationship between Osiris and Nephthys. - 3. Anubis is the outcome of the relationship between Osiris and Nephthys. - 4. Nephthys is infertile and Seth does not have a child. - Discussion.
